description: Diversity corpus for streaming-preview quality runs — distinct streaming shapes beyond the fixed questions.json baseline: heavy tool output, long fast prose, slow short answers, wide tables/separators, mixed code+prose. questions.json stays the unchanged cross-provider baseline; this set exercises the display-filter edge cases (chrome/status flap, tool-junk pane swap, wrapping).

questions.prompt: Run `ls -la /usr/bin | head -40` and then `python3 --help` and summarize each output in one sentence.
Print a markdown table with 6 columns (name, type, size, mode, owner, description) and 10 rows of plausible fake file entries. Table only, no prose.
Write a 25-sentence continuous explanation of how a shell pipeline works internally. No lists, no code, no headings — one long flowing text.
Print exactly five lines each consisting of 60 dash characters, with a one-word label line between them.
Show a bash script (one code block, ~15 lines) that backs up a directory, then explain it in exactly 3 sentences, then show a 2-line usage example code block.
Reply with exactly one word: pong.
Create a file probe-notes.txt with 20 numbered lines using a shell loop, show its full contents, then describe in 8 sentences what you did.
